Metadata.Title: Dentalist Clinic | Premium Cosmetic Dentistry
Metadata.Description: Experience transformative dentistry at Dentalist Clinic. Where art meets dental science. Specialized in veneers, implants, and total smile makeovers.

Hero.Subtitle: Premium Cosmetic Dentistry
Hero.Title: Your Most Beautiful Smile Starts Here
Hero.Description: At Dentalist Clinic, we combine cutting-edge technology with an unmatched sense of aesthetics to create smiles that are as healthy as they are stunning.

veneers.title: Porcelain Veneers
veneers.desc: Ultra-thin, custom-made porcelain shells that cover the front surface of teeth to instantly improve appearance.

implants.title: Dental Implants
implants.desc: Permanent, natural-looking tooth replacements that restore both function and aesthetics with surgical precision.

whitening.title: Teeth Whitening
whitening.desc: Professional-grade brightening treatments that remove years of stains and restore your natural radiance.

invisalign.title: Invisalign®
invisalign.desc: The clear alternative to braces. Straighten your teeth discreetly with custom-made removable aligners.

makeover.title: Smile Makeover
makeover.desc: A comprehensive combination of treatments designed to achieve your absolute dream smile.

general.title: Preventive Care
general.desc: Thorough cleaning, digital X-rays, and proactive care that keeps your smile healthy for a lifetime.

BeforeAfter.SectionTitle: The Art of the Perfect Smile
BeforeAfter.Description: Every smile is unique. Our before & after gallery showcases the life-changing transformations we've achieved for our patients at Dentalist Clinic.

Doctor.SectionTitle: A Vision for Beautiful, Healthy Smiles
Doctor.Description1: Dr. Aouetta Med Saleh is a board-certified cosmetic dentist specializing in advanced smile transformations. As the founder of Dentalist Clinic in Blida, he combines surgical precision with an artist's eye to create results that are as natural as they are spectacular.
Doctor.Description2: His philosophy is simple: every patient deserves a smile that reflects their best self. From a single veneer to a full mouth reconstruction, every treatment plan is meticulously tailored to the individual.

sarah.name: Sarah M.
sarah.text: I never thought I would feel this confident about my smile. Dr. Aouetta's artistry is unmatched — every detail was perfected. My veneers look completely natural and I get compliments every single day.

karim.name: Karim B.
karim.text: After losing a tooth in an accident, I was self-conscious for years. Dr. Aouetta gave me a permanent solution that looks and feels exactly like my natural teeth. The whole experience was painless and the outcome is incredible.

sofia.name: Sofia M.
sofia.text: The full smile makeover changed my life. Dr. Aouetta took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and delivered something even beyond my expectations. The clinic itself feels like a luxury spa.

ahmed.name: Ahmed L.
ahmed.text: Straight teeth at 38 seemed like a dream. With Dentalist's Invisalign program, it took less than a year. The team was supportive at every step and the results are simply stunning.

CTA.Subtitle: Begin Your Journey
CTA.Title: Your Dream Smile is One Appointment Away
CTA.Description: Schedule your complimentary consultation and let Dr. Aouetta Med Saleh design a personalised treatment plan tailored exactly to you.

VideoHighlight.Subtitle: The Dentalist Experience
VideoHighlight.Title: Where Beauty is <born>Born</born>

Hero.Subtitle: What We Offer
Hero.Title: Premium Dental Services
Hero.Description: Every treatment at Dentalist Clinic is performed with an unmatched level of care and precision. Here's how we can help transform your smile.

veneers.title: Porcelain Veneers
veneers.subtitle: The Gold Standard in Cosmetic Dentistry
veneers.description: Ultra-thin, custom-crafted porcelain shells are bonded to the front surface of your teeth, instantly correcting chips, cracks, and deep discoloration.

implants.title: Dental Implants
implants.subtitle: Permanent Solutions for Missing Teeth
implants.description: State-of-the-art titanium roots that provide a secure foundation for natural-looking porcelain crowns, restoring your bite and your confidence.

whitening.title: Teeth Whitening
whitening.subtitle: Professional-Grade Brightening
whitening.description: Advanced laser whitening and take-home systems that remove years of staining from coffee, tea, and age, revealing your brightest smile.

invisalign.title: Invisalign®
invisalign.subtitle: The Discreet Path to Straighter Teeth
invisalign.description: Virtually invisible clear aligners that gradually shift your teeth into the perfect position without the need for metal braces or wires.

makeover.title: Smile Makeover
makeover.subtitle: A Total Transformation
makeover.description: A comprehensive, multi-treatment plan designed to achieve your dream smile. We combine veneers, whitening, and more for maximum impact.

general.title: Preventive Care
general.subtitle: Foundation for a Lifetime of Health
general.description: Regular checkups, professional cleanings, and advanced diagnostics to ensure your smile remains healthy and beautiful for years to come.

Hero.Subtitle: Our Legacy
Hero.Title: Redefining Dental Care
Hero.Description: Founded by Dr. Aouetta Med Saleh, Dentalist Clinic is where clinical excellence meets artistic vision. We don't just treat teeth; we transform lives.

Philosophy.Title: Our Philosophy
Philosophy.Description: We believe that dentistry should be as comfortable as it is effective. Our approach combines a luxury spa-like environment with the most advanced medical technologies available.

Excellence.Title: Clinical Excellence
Excellence.Desc: We never compromise on quality. Every material and procedure is vetted against the highest global standards.

Artistry.Title: Artistic Vision
Artistry.Desc: A smile is a work of art. We consider facial symmetry, skin tone, and personality in every transformation.

Care.Title: Patient-Centric Care
Care.Desc: Your comfort is our priority. We offer a bespoke experience tailored to your unique needs and goals.

Hero.Subtitle: Visual Portfolio
Hero.Title: The Art of Transformation
Hero.Description: Explore our collection of real patient results. Each image represents a unique journey toward confidence and health.

Hero.Subtitle: Get In Touch
Hero.Title: Begin Your Transformation
Hero.Description: Ready to achieve your dream smile? Contact us today to schedule your personalized consultation.
